title: SpotifyConfig
description: supabase/functions/spotify-config/index.ts. Self-contained (no _shared/auth.ts import), authenticated (manually verifies the JWT inline rather than via requireUser/EntitlementService). Returns the PUBLIC Spotify OAuth client ID so the client can run the user-authorization PKCE flow itself (needed for favorite/add-to-playlist/follow-artist, which need a per-user token that Client Credentials — used by spotify-search — can't grant). The client ID is not a secret by design (it appears in every Spotify OAuth authorize URL); the client SECRET never leaves this function's environment.
